name: attract-button
title: Attract Button
description: A dark rounded call-to-action button with a magnet icon, ringed by a field of small iron filings drawn on a canvas. Moving the pointer nearby makes the filings rotate to point at it, and focussing the button pulls them inward.
use: A hero or waitlist needs a memorable primary button that reacts to the pointer without a big animation.
avoid: The canvas field reaches far past the button and needs spare space; on touch it only runs while pressed.
a11y: The button and its focus ring are solid; the canvas is hidden from assistive tech and reduced-motion leaves a static field. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A white, slightly rounded rectangular button with a small magnet icon and the label Join the waitlist, floating on a dark stage. Short dark grey dashes radiate outward in a loose ring around it, with a grey caption below.
behaves: At rest the filings hold a radial pattern with a slight jitter. When the pointer comes near they rotate on a spring to point toward it and brighten, and focussing the button pulls the whole field inward.
customise: Props set filing density, field radius, container classes and normal button attributes; the filings' physics, ink colour and spring constants need a source edit.
weight: light: A few hundred short lines drawn only while the field is settling.
demo: Button label Join the waitlist and the caption "Bring the cursor close and the filings line up."
issues: The filings are faint at rest and nearly disappear against the dark stage.
polishWhy: Distinctive, well-behaved magnetic detail; faint filings and a plain button shape.
